<!-- pr-reviewer: 55afbbf8b495fc7d9edceaa282e89ec50ce5bbe4 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge (the PR stays a draft on purpose).

## What looks good

- The full test keeps both strategies (Waterline and OffsetRings). The asserts move into the helper `assert_outside_starts_at_the_stock_edge`. I compared the old body and the new helper line by line: same `fig8_world()` set-up for each strategy, same `pocket_op` call (`PassStart::Outside`), same `levels.len() >= 2`, same `out >= R8 - 0.05`, same `(d - R8).abs() < 0.05`, same messages. No assert is lost.
- The heavy ignore reason names the lane: `heavy lane: app heavy: pocket_pass_start (94 s in debug, #3587)`. The test does not start red, so it needs no known-fail marker.
- The twin is `fig8_pocket_outside_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge_light`. It sits next to its full test. Its reason starts with `light lane:`. It runs the same helper on Waterline only.
- `#[test]` count: 6 before, 7 after (+1 twin). No test is deleted. The PR changes one file only.
- The body has the timing table, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3587`.

## Results, merged with main

Main at `9ff5013f0`. Built locally (not on the runner), `-j 6`. The trial merge is clean.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start` (debug) | 5 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (full test, twin). Binary time 47.04 s |
| Twin alone, debug (`-- --ignored ..._light --exact`) | 1 passed, 43.28 s |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run` | shows `app heavy: pocket_pass_start` (`--release ... --ignored`) |
| `cargo xtask gate light --dry-run` | shows `app light: pocket_pass_start` with the twin as filter |

The gate accepts the twin: it has an `#[ignore]`d full test in the same file. The suite now has its heavy step because a source has `ignore` (filter of PR #3709).

## Heavy lanes

- `app heavy: pocket_pass_start`: the author ran it on this head (8.35 s, release, ok; the PR body names it). Not run here.
- `app light: pocket_pass_start`: the author ran it (3.62 s, release, ok). Not run here.
- The diff touches one test file. It reaches only this heavy lane.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `fig8_zigzag_pocket_says_pass_start_is_not_used` takes 44.88 s in the body table. It is under the 60 s rule. The binary has 47 s of debug time now, so this test is the next one to watch. A separate P7 issue is optional.
- The twin takes 43 s in debug. It is `#[ignore]`d, so it does not add to the debug suite. It is fast in release (3.62 s).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
